This deck

  • Deck610 sf main deck, 77 sf landing, the upper deck 4'-9" x 7'-8" at the second floor
  • DeckingTimberTech Advanced PVC, Vintage collection: English Walnut 5-1/2 in field boards run to the house walls; Dark Hickory 7-1/4 in (wide width) picture frame on three sides, on the open edges only (10 border boards on the main deck), and 4 dividers; no border board along a house wall; Dark Hickory fascia on every edge; stair treads and risers English Walnut; Cortex screws and plugs on every board; no butt joints
  • FrameHigh decks (the triangle, the middle part, the south-east walkway, the east strip over the garage and the driveway and the upper deck): Fortress Evolution steel posts, beams and joists. Low decks (the west part, the landing and the wedge step of stair S2): CEMCO steel joists on Fortress Evolution steel beams and posts. Joists at 12 in on center. 19 concrete piers
  • Posts8 Fortress Evolution steel posts under the deck, 29 TimberTech Fulton steel rail posts, two steel posts for the shade sail
  • RailTimberTech Fulton steel rail, black, 36 in: 29 posts, 19 level panels, 4 stair panels, 2 gates; the gate at the top of the front stair is one leaf (42 in opening) and a fixed panel
  • StairsS1 9 risers, S2 10 risers, W3 3 risers, on steel stringers
  • ShadeA shade sail over the west part, on two black steel posts at the south corners of the west part (tops 9 ft 8 in above the deck, each set in its own concrete footing) and two anchors on the house wall. The homeowner buys the sail and its hardware kit; GSX installs it. The sail is made to the four anchor points. Sail color as drawn: charcoal.
  • Lights27 rail lights, 19 riser lights · LED 2700 K
